newsitem.title: USA: Federated sees Q4 same-store sales growth.
newsitem.headline: Federated sees Q4 same-store sales growth.

text.p: Federated Department Stores Inc on Wednesday said the company is optimistic that its same store sales will continue to show growth in the fourth quarter, with larger increases seen in November because of year-to-year variances in the retail calendar.
The firm plans to open four Bloomingdale's stores this week in California, with a fifth store set to open in Beverly Hills in the spring of 1997.
Earlier, today Federated reported net income $41.8 million or 20 cents a share for the quarter ended November 2, 1996, versus a 1995 third quarter net loss of $46.4 million or 24 cents a share.
